cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the concert chairs where they are. We promised to bring this village together, and we're starting on time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out. Nobody will hear the microphones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move the singers in among the chairs. I'll give the first note; everyone can join without a microphone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home to fetch torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave their places ready and start with the people here. When they come back, bring them down the middle with the lights. They've found another way to join in.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 controls chairs and start under togetherness promise; A3 directs singers and first note after outage; A5 incorporates torch-fetchers into a planned entrance, using leadership to expand participation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2 silent microphones for unamplified collective singing; A5 uses B4 helpful departure to plan their return as another form of joining.

relationship.evidence: B2 reports equipment problem and B4 reports audience solution, materially informing A rather than inventing obstruction.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 solution a new fulfillment of togetherness; no additional obstacle is required.

specificity.evidence: A1 concert chairs and A3 singers among them establish staging; A5 when they return preserves actual timeline.
